chapter.p: UTF-16 code points to 2-byte sequence writer. CodeUnitSWriter which models swriter<utf16::code_unit_t> (see ) is used as a code units output.

synopsis.p: Returns reference to the used code unit writer.

synopsis.prototype: template<class... Args> explicit writer(Args&&... args) C++11
synopsis.p: Forwards all parameters to the used code unit writer.
Writes the specified code point according to UTF-16 encoding rules. CodeUnitSWriter::operator() is used to write individual code units.
Creates UTF-16 writer using specified CodeUnitSWriter.
